messages:
Maya (Docs): Heads-up: I'm drafting a short model-card update for lyra-embed-8b to add client-side sharding examples and a quant limit note. Can someone sanity-check?

Drew (ML): Quick confirm: quantized q8 variant behaves unpredictably past ~8192 tokens — we should document 8192 as the practical limit and warn about degraded vector quality.

Ivy (SDK): I'll replace the old .embed() snippet with embeddings.create and add a simple Promise.all pattern for parallelizing shard calls. Example will show batching shards to trade throughput/latency.

Jon (Eng): Please avoid recommending internal headers like X-Embed-Shard in the public docs. Show a stable-hash bucket pattern instead. I'll file a redirect for any old slugs if you need it.

Maya (Docs): Got it — will add: "sequence_limit: 8192 (quantized: best-effort truncation; quality may degrade)" plus a tiny Node hash-bucket snippet and a throughput note.

InfraBot: Redirect request infra-redirects#58 created for legacy /models/lyra -> /catalog/models/lyra-embed-8b.

Maya (Docs): Thanks all — I'll push the PR and ping for review once redirect is live.

Jon (Eng): Redirect deployed.

Maya (Docs): PR merged after CI green. Closing thread.
